agPivot.heroTitle: Feed the Soil. Grow the Crop.
agPivot.heroSubtitle: Synthetic fertility feeds the plant and ignores the soil. SuperN works differently — biologically active, phased nitrogen release, 100% organic. Built for farmers who are done compromising.

compromiseSection.title: Organic fertility has a performance problem. We fixed it.
paragraphs: Most organic amendments are too slow, too dilute, or formulated for somewhere other than here. They were designed to meet a certification standard, not to move the needle in the field.

We started from a different place. SuperN is built around soil biology first — how nitrogen releases, how microbes activate, how prairie soils behave at high pH. The result is fertility that performs from germination through grain fill, in a single application at seeding.

products.name: SuperN
products.headline: SuperN 10-2-0
products.subheadline: High-nitrogen organic starter. Two-phase nitrogen release.
products.description: A high-nitrogen organic starter with a two-phase release window. Fast nitrogen at germination. Sustained nitrogen through to harvest. BSFL frass activates soil biology alongside the nitrogen program from day one.

products.name: OrganiPhos
products.headline: OrganiPhos 1-8-0 + 23% Ca
products.subheadline: Biological phosphorus for alkaline prairie soils.
products.description: A biological phosphorus starter built for alkaline soils where phosphorus fixation limits availability. Three staggered phosphorus sources, 23% calcium, and biological activators that keep phosphorus in plant-available form when it matters most.

howSoilWorksSection.title: Built around how soil actually functions.
paragraphs: Conventional fertilizers bypass biology and deliver nutrients directly to the plant. Fast results, long-term cost.

SuperN is designed around biological activation. Nitrogen releases in phases that match crop demand. Chitin from BSFL frass drives phosphorus-solubilizing bacteria in the root zone. Biochar creates permanent microbial habitat. Humalite helps manage phosphorus dynamics on high-pH soils.
You are not just applying fertility. You are building a system that improves year over year.

fitSection.title: For farmers moving in the right direction.
paragraphs: Whether you are certified organic, transitioning, regenerative, or biodynamic—if you are building your farm around soil health and need fertility products that keep up, you are in the right place.
No synthetic chemistry. No greenwashed conventional inputs with an organic label. Just products that work the way healthy soil does.

storySection.title: Built by a farmer. Grounded in soil science.

sections.title: The Founder
sections.paragraph: Lee Martineau farms north of Bearberry, Alberta. He did not come to regenerative agriculture through a textbook. He came through the same frustration most producers know well: the tools available did not match the problem in front of him. That gap led to Terra Preta Ag.

sections.title: Why Terra Preta
sections.paragraph: Terra preta means dark earth in Portuguese. It refers to ancient Amazonian soils deliberately enriched centuries ago using biochar, bone, and organic matter. Those soils remain extraordinarily fertile today, long after the civilizations that built them are gone. That is not a coincidence. It is a principle. Soil health is not about feeding plants. It is about building biological systems that sustain fertility season after season without synthetic inputs. That idea is the foundation of everything Terra Preta Ag makes.

sections.title: How It Started
sections.paragraph: The question was straightforward: why does organic fertility have to mean manure equipment, lost seasons, or unreliable results? It does not. SuperN was built to deliver a targeted nitrogen program from a single pass at seeding. No extra equipment. No fallowing. No compromises on certification for producers who need it. It is the product Lee wished existed before he had to build it himself.

sections.title: Who We Work With
sections.paragraph: Terra Preta Ag works directly with producers across the prairies. Organic, transitioning, and conventional producers who believe that healthy soil and strong yields are the same goal. We are not a big ag company. We do not have a 1-800 number or a dealer network. You talk to us directly, and we help you figure out whether our products fit your operation before you spend a dollar.
